name: Ho Chi Minh City to the Mekong
summary: A day tour reaches the near delta. Can Tho and the dawn floating market need a night there. Budget about four hours on the road.

modes.note: The ordinary way to Can Tho.
Worth it for a group or a dawn boat the next morning.
My Tho or Ben Tre style trips. They are not the Cai Rang market.

seoTitle: Ho Chi Minh City to the Mekong Delta
seoDescription: Day tour versus a night in Can Tho, and how long the road south takes.

faqs.q: Which delta town should you sleep in?
faqs.a: Can Tho, if the floating market is the goal.
